So this framework is three levels. We're going to just call it the operating system. This operating system is three levels: Level 1, Level 2, Level 3.
So Level 1 is the foundational level. This is the basic level. This is the level that you literally have to have mostly handled to really be effective at the next levels. So Level 1 is your fuel, how well you move, and how well you rest. Fuel, movement, and rest—FMR for short. We'll just say that. Level 1: FMR—fuel, movement, and rest.

Once you get your process down where you're thinking well, you feel like you're grounded internally, now it's time to shift to external. Your external foundation, or the external...
Once you get Level 1—you get your foundation generally figured out—and you've worked on Level 2—you're thinking well, you're processing, you're challenging yourself, you're pushing yourself, you're connected—connected at the end of Level 2 leads right to Level 3. Organization is my next step. So, are you organized? When I say organized, you might think, "I'm going to put that into the internal one," and yeah, that is somewhat going to help with that. Your purpose, that connects to Level 2 in the way you connect to your Creator, those deeper values. What is your purpose? What goals do you have? Why are you doing all this? All of these things come to living a fulfilled, healthy life.
So let me overall summarize this. There's three levels to the Systemized Operating System, the Systemized OS: foundational, internal, and external.
